sections: Infrastructure Ledger | January 10, 2026

Cedar Intertie signs to sell its network. On January 9, 2026, Cedar Intertie first made public a definitive agreement signed January 8, 2026 with Northline Infrastructure, the buyer. Cedar Intertie operates electric transmission infrastructure in the United States.

The reported enterprise value was US$1.2 billion. A separate US$300 million credit facility will fund construction. Hawthorne Advisory advised Northline Infrastructure on the acquisition. The acquisition vehicle's specific fund was not disclosed.
Harborline Fibre deploys a new link. Harborline Fibre said a new 220 km fiber network between two Canadian cities entered service on January 7, 2026. This is an operating development.

Infrastructure Ledger | February 2, 2026
Sale exploration at Meridian Grid. Meridian Grid has begun considering strategic options, according to people familiar with the matter. No counterparty or binding agreement has been announced.
New fund commitment. Clearvale Retirement Trust committed US$75 million to Northline Infrastructure Fund III, according to the manager. The fund's financing arrangements were not disclosed.
Infrastructure Ledger | March 12, 2026

Regulators approve Northline's previously announced acquisition of Cedar Intertie. A state commission approved the deal on March 11, 2026, after its first formal public disclosure on January 9, 2026. Closing remains pending.
Infrastructure Ledger | May 4, 2026
Northline Infrastructure closed its Cedar Intertie acquisition on May 1, 2026. Cedar Intertie first publicly disclosed the definitive agreement on January 9, 2026.

Sign-and-close at Orchard Utility Services. Hillcroft Infrastructure signed and closed, and first disclosed, its purchase of Orchard Utility Services on May 2, 2026. Orchard operates distributed electricity networks in the United States.
Infrastructure Ledger | October 12, 2026 | Year to date
The year-to-date review recalls the Northline Infrastructure acquisition of Cedar Intertie, announced January 9, 2026 and completed May 1, 2026. The recap contains no new agreement or progress.
Infrastructure Ledger | October 13, 2026
Prestwick Wind submitted a planning application to expand a wind farm. The application was filed October 12, 2026.
